entries.1db94630c8ebd2fa: Since its founding in 1887, the company has adopted 'The highest quality is the greatest service' as its corporate motto, and states that its strength lies in its efforts to improve quality and drive technological innovation with a focus on 'writing and drawing.' The company states that its products, led by the highest-quality pencil 'Uni', launched in 1958, are patronized by customers in more than 100 countries worldwide, not only in Japan.

entries.297063df11dec810: This business manufactures and sells writing instruments and writing-related products such as cosmetics, applying technology developed in the writing instrument business. In Japan, products are manufactured by uni Co., Ltd., Yamagata Mitsubishi Pencil Seiko Co., Ltd., Unipolymer Co., Ltd. and others, and overseas, by Shenzhen Xinhualing Stationery Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and subsidiaries in Vietnam and others. Sales are handled by domestic sales companies and overseas sales companies, including uni-ball Corporation in the United States, and C. Josef Lamy GmbH manufactures and sells LAMY-brand writing instruments and others. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥87,355 million.

entries.fdc8d185da96281f: Toward 2036, the year it marks its 150th anniversary, the company has set out its long-term vision 'Ideal State 2036', aiming to become 'the world's leading expressive innovation company', and has stated its corporate brand concept (corporate philosophy) as 'Difference Is Beautiful.' As a step toward achieving this, the company is working under the basic policy 'uni Advance' in its medium-term management plan covering 2025 to 2027, and its three priority policies are continuing growth and diversification of the writing instruments business, expanding scale in the non-writing instruments business, and strengthening the growth foundation in cooperation with stakeholders.
